Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was very naughty. One day, she wanted to play outside, but it was too tough to go. Lucy was sad, but then she had an idea.

Lucy went to her friend, Mr. Bear, and he showed her a big bow. Lucy was very excited, because Mr. Bear looked good. He said, "Lucy, I want you to play with Mr. Bear. Can you teach me a lot?"
